name: Brazil MAPA absent quarantine pests
scope: Official absent quarantine pests; plants, forestry and agricultural trade. Listing does not mean occurrence in Brazil. Genus-only entries are excluded.

name: Brazil MAPA present quarantine pests
scope: Official present quarantine pests under control; selected regulated taxa, not all Brazilian agricultural pests.

name: China MARA agricultural quarantine list
scope: National agricultural quarantine list, including insects, nematodes, pathogens and weeds. Genus-only and non-eukaryotic entries excluded.

name: China import quarantine catalogue
scope: Official import quarantine catalogue: 493 species/genera across source categories; explicit eukaryotic species only. Non-Chinese and strain restrictions remain source qualifiers.

name: Canada CFIA regulated pests
scope: Official plant protection list: agricultural, horticultural and forest pests/pathogens. Restrictions may apply to specific races or source regions.

name: Japan MAFF quarantine pests
scope: Current official quarantine table (not the future table effective December 2026): arthropods, nematodes, molluscs and fungi. Unknown-agent diseases, bacteria and viruses are excluded.

name: Ghana NPPO quarantine list
version: October 2017 content; IPPC attachment 2020-12-04, report republished 2026-07-16
scope: Historical NPPO crop-specific quarantine insects/mites, diseases and nematodes. Preserved as a dated source, not a claim of current legal status. Source presence flags do not represent genome sample origins.

name: Australia DAFF priority plant pests
scope: National priority plant pests/diseases and vectors; includes exotic species/strains. Hash is of the reviewed scientific-name transcription, not original HTML. Genus-only/non-eukaryotic entries excluded.

name: Australia Bioplatforms IPM
scope: Reviewed agricultural pest, pollinator and biocontrol projects from national IPM programme. A sequencing target is not evidence of an already released qualifying assembly. Non-agricultural/unidentified projects excluded.
